title: Gopher check
description: Connects to a Gopher server, sends a selector and reads the menu or document it returns.

host.description: Gopher server host name or IP address, e.g. gopher.acme.com

selector.description: Selector to request. Empty asks for the root menu.

timeout.description: Run budget as a duration, e.g. 10s (at most 30s).
